id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

backwardIcon.description: The icon for the backward button.

pauseIcon.description: The icon for the pause button.

playIcon.description: The icon for the pause button.

forwardIcon.description: The icon for the forward button.

playSpeeds.description:
A list of the available play speeds for the time bar.
Each of these speeds are multiplied by the TIME_BAR_BASE_SPEED that is 60 pixels per second,
meaning the value is actualy a multiplier other than a fixed speed value to update.

defaultSpeed.description:
The default speed value for the time bar. This will be the value selected in {@link playSpeeds} dropdown
The time bar will start with this speed (multiplied by 60 pixels per second)

title: A UI Component type that represents time bar controls for {@link UiSdlGraphVisualization} instance.
name: UiSdlGraphVisualizationTimeBarControlBar
